resourceName: Inner Mongolia Arxan Improved Forest Management Project
description:
The Inner Mongolia Arxan Improved Forest Management Project is implemented by Arxan Forest Industry Co., LTD, Inner Mongolia Forest Industry Group to protect the once logging forest, which located in south region of the Greater Khingan Mountains, P.R.China. The geographic coordinate of Arxan Forest Industry Co., LTD is 119°36’26’’~120°54’00’’E and 47°03’26’’~47°55’45’’N, the total area is 483,861 ha, of which 482,786.25 ha is the forestry area, accounting 99.8% of the total area.
The proposed project is implemented in 14 Forestry Centres, which are affiliated to Arxan Forest Industry Co., LTD. The project has approximately 66,897.46 ha commercial forest, whose ages ranging from middle age to mature forest. Before the implementation of the project, the forest within the project area was designed and planted as commercial forest, and logged annually according to the timber production plan. The main object of the project is to improve the forest coverage rate, protect local ecological environment, reduce carbon emissions and carbon sequestration by enhance the management level and converse logged to protected forest within the project area. The implementation of the project will result in significant carbon sequestration and improve the sustainable development of ecological system.The estimated annual emission reduction of the project is 423,178 tCO2e, and the total estimated emission reductions will reach 8,463,570 tCO2e with 20 years’ crediting period. According to the Non-Permanence Risk Report, with buffering deducting, the estimated annual emission reduction of the project is 372,397 tCO2e, and the total estimated emission reductions will reach 7,447,941 tCO2e during the 20 years’ crediting period.
